# MARLO

> MARLO (Managing Agricultural Research for Learning and Outcomes) is CGIAR's strategic results management and reporting platform for complex agricultural research programs.

MARLO helps research initiatives and multi-country programs plan work, monitor progress, manage deliverables and innovations, run quality assurance, and produce donor-ready reports with structured workflows, BI insights, and AI-assisted narrative support.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://marlo.cgiar.org/): Product overview, capabilities, impact, and call to request a demo
- [About](https://marlo.cgiar.org/about): Platform history and the Knowledge and Data Sharing (KDS) team
- [Request a demo](https://marlo.cgiar.org/contact): Contact the MARLO team for a personalized walkthrough
- [FAQs](https://marlo.cgiar.org/faqs): Common questions about scope, frameworks, security, and support
- [Team & technology](https://marlo.cgiar.org/team): People and stack behind the platform
- [What's new](https://marlo.cgiar.org/whats-new): Recent features, improvements, and fixes
